title: Connect an existing repository: demo storage, repository list, and starting the grilling agent again
story: Connecting a repository used to mean typing owner/repository; it now shows your repositories with your access to each, with a search box, and Check access stays for re-checking or for a repository typed in full. The in-memory demo store now answers for its seeded repositories and invitation, so Check access and saving after Accept work there. A grilling agent that was refused no longer dead-ends: Open on the project under Your projects shows the failed start with Try again, even after leaving the screen or closing Grillo.

checks.criterion: The connect flow shows the member's repositories in a searchable list.
checks.steps: Set GRILLO_STORE=memory and run npm run dev. Open the Project tab, press New project, then Connect an existing one. Type team in Search your repositories. Type no-such, then clear the box. Pick example-org/company-handbook, then example-org/team-docs.
checks.expected: Three repositories with Read access only, Write access and Admin access badges. team leaves two rows and the box keeps focus. no-such shows "No repository of yours matches this search." company-handbook says it needs write access with inviting greyed out. team-docs is highlighted with inviting enabled.

checks.criterion: Under GRILLO_STORE=memory, Check access on the seeded repository shows its real access level.
checks.steps: With the same start, on Connect an existing one, pick example-org/team-code and press Check access.
checks.expected: "Write access" on the highlighted row, and never "Access not known".

checks.criterion: Saving after accepting the seeded invitation succeeds.
checks.steps: On the Project tab under the memory store, press Accept on kickoff-notes, then Save and open the project.
checks.expected: The map of example-org/kickoff-notes, with no "not found" error.

checks.criterion: A project whose grilling agent failed to start can start it again later, also after leaving the creation screen.
checks.steps: Under the memory store, connect example-org/team-code with a made-up idea and press Connect and start; the agent step fails. Press Open the map, go back to the Project tab and press Open on team-code. Press Try again.
checks.expected: One "Grilling agent started…" row marked Failed, its reason, and Try again and Open the map. Try again runs the start again; under the memory store it is refused again for the same reason.
